source: dinsync.info TB-303 reference recordings (test/resources/x0x-reference, 400 notes, one ~40-year-old unit), with Stinchcombe's full coupling network
component_state: as recorded: the x0x unit (low TM3 cutoff trim, aged C13); ladder capacitors at the schematic values
notes: The x0x unit refitted on Stinchcombe's full coupling network (filterCouplingNetwork 1, TB303_REFERENCE.md 11.1) with the ladder capacitors at the schematic 33/33/33/18 nF. Staged fit from x0x (docs/STINCHCOMBE_NETWORK_2026-10-03.md): 40 notes with every knob at an end stop (knobs at the chart values, 900 ms, 35 min), then quarter 0 (knobs free, prior 0.3, 900 ms, 45 min), then quarter 2 (full length, 40 min); --w-sweep 1 --w-harmt 2, filterResonanceLimit bounded to 0.9-0.995; cutoff end stops folded into the cutoff law. All 400 notes: weighted error 3.39 (x0x: 3.35 under the same scoring), resonant-peak shape 3.24 dB (x0x 3.55), harmonics over time 5.29 dB (5.30), sweep track 3.67 semitones (3.19). Conformance 28 / 34 (x0x 24). The fit lands on schematic values the Open303 topology needs compensations for: feedback 18.78 (Stinchcombe 18.7), VEG 1.54 s (R123 x C42 1.5 s), post-filter HP 69 Hz (220k VCA tap 72 Hz, x0x 199 Hz).
